sections.heading: What BolCash is
paragraphs: BolCash is a digital udhar khata and cash book app for small shops. It is made to help you record credit and cash on your phone.
The app is not launched yet.

sections.heading: Who it is for
paragraphs: BolCash is for kirana, medical, dairy, hardware and wholesale shop owners, and for street vendors.

sections.heading: What this website is for
paragraphs: This website has plain-language guides, free tools and pages about the app. The tools run in your browser.

sections.heading: How we write our guides
paragraphs: We use short sentences and plain words. Each guide shows the date it was last updated and links to the official sources.
We do not make up facts, numbers or reviews. Where we are not sure, we write TODO: verify on the page.
